name: Yingwei
bio: I’m going to be an incoming freshman in college and majoring in environmental sciences. I’ve become passionate about environmentalism through habitat restoration volunteer events where I engaged in hands-on work that improved the habitat for native species. My interest deepened when I learned about environmental politics that addressed the use of natural resources in environmental internships that I participated in while I was in high school. Thus, my goal for BAYC is to raise awareness about environmental justice especially towards underrepresented communities and to collaborate with many more young people with environmental stewardship.
